statement: Fix d ≥ 2, 0 < α < d, and ρ > 0. There are positive constants η0, γ and ∆0 with the following consequence. If 0 < η ≤ η0, 0 < ∆ < ∆0, A lies in a fixed unit ball, ∆−α+η ≤ N∆(A) ≤ ∆−α−η , N∆(A ∩ B(x, r)) ≤ ∆−η rρ N∆(A) (∆ ≤ r ≤ 1), and ν is a probability law on unit kernel directions satisfying ν{v : |v · w| < r} ≤ ∆−η rρ (|w| = 1, ∆ ≤ r ≤ 1), (2.7) 6 then some direction in the support of ν has N∆(πv⊥ A′ ) ≥ ∆−(d−1)α/d−γ for every A′ ⊂ A with N∆(A′ ) ≥ ∆η N∆(A). (2.8) Fixed multiplicative constants and bounded affine normalizations in the hypotheses are allowed after reducing η0, γ.
